
QUERY-DEPENDENCY-STATS
Show dependency statistics and potential blockers

WHEN TO USE
  Use to identify dependency bottlenecks, blocked work units, and critical paths.

USAGE
  fspec query-dependency-stats [options]

OPTIONS
  --show-critical-path
    Highlight critical path through dependencies

EXAMPLES
  1. Show dependency stats
  $ fspec query-dependency-stats
  Total dependencies: 42
Blocking work units: 5
Blocked work units: 8
Work units with no dependencies: 20

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec export-dependencies
  fspec add-dependency
